title: Frog
notes: What are the end products of carbohydrate, protein and fat digestion.

Digestion is the process of conversion of complex food particles into simpler forms.
For this, various organs are co-ordinating or working together called digestive organs forming a complex system called digestive system.
Mainly two processes involve in the process of digestion which are mechanical and chemical.
Mechanical process is the conversion of larger food particles into smaller or fine state whereas chemical pocess is the conversion of complex organic compound in food into simpler forms.
